summary: The candidate disables receive-side auto maintenance on the shared temporary bare remote before any seed push, and the new regression test forces loose-object maintenance conditions and proves a real repair-store push starts no maintenance or gc process. The flaky Passport test uses makeRig as maintenanceRig, so the background writer that could race reads or cleanup is removed. No introduced defect was found.

evidence: `tests/host/hosted-autonomy-rig.ts` sets `receive.autogc` to `false` on `ctx.bare` immediately after `makeRemoteCtx` and before the repair and release seed pushes, so `git receive-pack` does not detach `git maintenance run --auto` on any rig push.

`tests/host/hosted-autonomy-rig_test.ts` forces `maintenance.loose-objects.auto` to `-1` on the bare remote, then asserts the `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` trace from a real repair store write contains no maintenance or gc start event; on Git 2.55/2.56 receive auto maintenance defaults on, so this guard fails without the rig change.
`tests/host/passport-work-trial_test.ts` imports `makeRig` as `maintenanceRig`, so the reported flaky case runs against the same receive-maintenance-disabled fixture.
